# C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map

## #0

Bimba is Original; pratibimba is its situated display or reflection. The ontological relation preserves display without severance and dependence without diminishment. A Bimba Map is the authorial technical design by which a locally governed reference field can orient multiple judgments. These offices must remain explicit whenever the same term crosses scale.

## #1

Ontological Bimba is prior in being and later in recognition: the Original is recognised through proportions, inversions and differences among appearances which do not exhaust it. Dyczkowski's source-matched mirror discussion places manifestation within consciousness, with no separately existing exterior original required. The doctrine is a source-specific neighbour of the native QL mirror relation, not an ancient description of a database.

## #2

The native parents `(0/1)/(1/0)` and `(1/0)/(0/1)` carry the complete body in inverse orientations. The first and returned accounts preserve their source relation. The optical relation places QL in the light's ordered spectrum, MEF in the refracting apparatus and pratibimba in the cast image. A technical world-picture is thus a reflection relative to the wider world; renaming it cannot make it metaphysically Original.

The paradigm/project relation gives reflection a consequential office within the world it discloses. A **Project** is a determination thrown forth through a **Paradigm** into a World; a pratibimba can therefore become an effective condition of what happens next. The `/↔1` relation names this projection/enactment. A revised map can change a route and become the reference for later journeys. Its authority in those journeys remains derived from the encountered world, sources and rules through which it was made. Its causal effectiveness and its dependence are simultaneous features of the same projection.

## #3

Recursive locality nevertheless gives a real reference office. Inside a declared Context Frame, a source record or agreed world-object can serve as Bimba for judgments compared with it. That same field remains pratibimba relative to wider sources and reality. Within the [recursive Bimba relation](bimba-pratibimba.md), local authority can be strong and operational while its determining sources remain available beyond that office.

This is also a paradigmatic office. A local Bimba can organise source, gauge, lens and admissible relation strongly enough to condition a subsequent inquiry. The healthier case keeps that organisation visible as mediation and lets returned resistance revise the local original. The counterfeit case appears when the map becomes the sole authorised route through which its wider source is permitted to appear. A [world-atlas](../A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) relates projections through transitions which remain answerable to the paradigms that made them legible.

## #4

The map exposes provisional world-objects, source authority, lens, gauge, exclusions, transformation and governance as parts of the inquiry. This makes disagreement locatable: two judgments can diverge because their evidence differs, because they refer to different objects, or because permission and evaluation differ. A federation can keep several locally authoritative maps with declared transition rules instead of requiring one universal map. In a local comparison, the judging agent is the relative functional knower; source, memory, lens and rule are means; the alternative judgments or addressed field are known. Within the containing person’s inquiry, that whole apparatus serves as means. Its local determining centre can become known in another inquiry without losing the office it occupied in the first.

At this level **holographic** does not mean that a local map contains the whole. It means that the local reference can retain, at its own scale, the relation among source, mediation and projected determination. A Bimba Map is strongest when this whole-relation remains recoverable while the map performs its finite office; its recursive source-dependence is part of its authority, not a defect to conceal.

## #5→0


Baudrillard reverses Borges’s map fable and then contests even its remaining map/territory distinction. A made map nevertheless genuinely serves as local Bimba within a Context Frame while remaining pratibimba toward wider sources, including sources that can revise that local reference.

The [window’s ordered light and situated view](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction) differentiate Bimba as Original order, QL as the full ordered spectrum immanent to light, MEF as refractive operation and pratibimba as situated projection. Within a declared Context Frame an achieved image genuinely becomes local Bimba while remaining pratibimba toward its wider source. Returned comparison can revise that local original. This recursive authority is real, with neither the produced artifact made metaphysically Original nor finite reference stripped of its governing office.

In [Indra’s jewel-net](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence), one jewel presents the others, including their return through it, giving recursive local reference a contemplative image. In the technical comparison, an agreed record can genuinely serve as Bimba for a judgment while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. That local authority remains revisable; the reflected ink mark alone establishes no institutional correction.

In the [mirror’s initiated return](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-recursive-bimba), a real local Bimba operates within a declared Context Frame: an agreed record or world-object orients judgments that are its pratibimbas. The same reference remains pratibimba toward wider sources, and persistent resistance can revise the local original itself. The mirror’s initiative preserves both its authority to orient comparison and its answerability beyond that office.

The [travelling jigsaw’s made world-picture](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) genuinely serves as local Bimba within a declared Context Frame. Situated readings are its pratibimbas; the reference picture remains pratibimba toward wider sources and can itself be corrected. The reconstructed atlas retains that real local authority together with its recursive answerability.

The [stained-glass encounter](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-return) makes this recursive office explicit: an achieved reference can be Bimba for its local readings and pratibimba within a wider relation. Recognition can revise the local original itself while preserving enough stability for comparison and error to have a definite address.

[Account does not replace source](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#account-does-not-replace-source) gives this office a consequential distinction. A local Bimba governs reference within a bounded inquiry while remaining source-dependent and revisable within a wider frame. An encountered correction can reach that local reference itself; the corrected account retains which source, respect and authority made the correction warranted.

Through [paradigm, project and enactment](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD-genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos.md#1--paradigm-through-project-projection--enactment), a projected reference orients future determinations and becomes causally active while retaining its source-dependence. Paradigmatic reflexivity makes the map’s source, gauge and exclusions answerable. A failure reaches the condition capable of correcting it; a fitting condition can be retained with reasons. A later act inherits the relevant correction or warranted retention.

Returned evidence can revise a situated judgment, a relation between reference fields, or the local Bimba itself. Stability provides orientation; corrigibility preserves truth-seeking. A map anchors by attributable source relations and contestable construction, not by storing Truth. Through [Objective Co-Internality](C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md), distinct local worlds make their consequences conditions of one another’s next acts. The [Reflective Field](C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) lets a map turn its own authority first toward its source.

An achieved [avatar, image or mask](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) can genuinely serve as local Bimba for further readings within a declared Context Frame. It remains pratibimba toward its wider sources, and the comparisons it makes possible can return to revise the local original itself. The four-office ecology keeps that authority effective: idolisation concerns immunity from sourceward correction, not the mere fact that a bounded reference governs an inquiry.
